dispatch_intents_check.name: dispatch_intents_check
dispatch_intents_check.value: ((operation_type = 'import'::text) AND (import_id IS NOT NULL) AND (run_id IS NULL)) OR ((operation_type = 'calculation'::text) AND (run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (import_id IS NULL))

monthly_sales_check.name: monthly_sales_check
monthly_sales_check.value: ((completeness = ANY (ARRAY['complete'::text, 'explicit_none'::text])) AND (quantity IS NOT NULL)) OR ((completeness = ANY (ARRAY['missing'::text, 'invalid'::text])) AND (quantity IS NULL))

recommendations_check.name: recommendations_check
recommendations_check.value: ((quantity_status = 'known'::text) AND (recommended_quantity IS NOT NULL) AND (data_quality <> 'unavailable'::text) AND (urgency <> 'unknown'::text)) OR ((quantity_status = 'unavailable'::text) AND (recommended_quantity IS NULL) AND (data_quality = 'unavailable'::text))

sales_check.name: sales_check
sales_check.value: (customer_key_available AND (anonymous_customer_key IS NOT NULL)) OR ((NOT customer_key_available) AND (anonymous_customer_key IS NULL))

source_objects_check1.name: source_objects_check1
source_objects_check1.value: ((purpose = 'source'::text) AND (content_type = ANY (ARRAY['application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'::text, 'text/csv'::text, 'application/zip'::text]))) OR ((purpose = 'report'::text) AND (content_type = ANY (ARRAY['application/json'::text, 'text/csv'::text]))) OR ((purpose = 'export'::text) AND (content_type = 'text/csv'::text))
